name: roomCountConventions
description: How markets count rooms. Defines what UnitSpecs.rooms means for a given location.countryCode (always the number a local listing prints) and gives operators a default presentation convention. Informative.

items.description: Advertised rooms include the living room; half rooms (0.5) are common; a studio is advertised as one room or as a studio.
Zimmer counts living and sleeping rooms, half rooms for small rooms; kitchen and bathrooms excluded.
Zimmer as in Germany; half rooms for dining nooks or small rooms.
Zimmer counts living and sleeping rooms.
Pieces count living and sleeping rooms, kitchen and bathrooms excluded (T3 = two bedrooms plus a living room).
Locali count habitable rooms; a separate kitchen is often counted.
Kamers count living and sleeping rooms.
Listings state bedrooms and bathrooms (3 BR / 2 BA).
Habitaciones usually means bedrooms on portals.
The tipologia counts bedrooms (T2 = two bedrooms).
